inputs.text: [excited] Kam… AR… uh… SOR… us. [curious] In Greek, "kamara" means a chamber — a little room.
[happily] Yep — its bones had hollow spaces inside, [amazed] like tiny little rooms. It lived in North America, a hundred fifty-five million years ago.
[confident] Just the opposite! [proud] It was the most common sauropod in that whole region, back then.
